article.x: Town rank is a feature in Coral Island introduced early on in the game. Town rank system, starting with F, is introduced by [[connor|Connor]], through [[quest|town rank F cutscene]]. The town rank affects store inventories, [[crop|crops and seeds]] available to the player, [[farm-animal|farm animals]] the player can purchase and raise, among other things. The player can raise the town's rank by donating to the [[museum|museum]], completing [[lake-temple|temple]] [[lake-temple|offering]]s, and cleaning the ocean while [[diving|diving]].
Points and scoring

Town rank increases based on total points the player accumulates doing ranked activities. New [[crop|crops]], [[farm-animal|animals]], and other items will be available in stores as the town rank changes. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town as the town rank improves.

article.x: The town rank points are divided into four categories: [[museum|Museum]] points earned for museum donations, Ocean points earned for restoring corals while [[diving|diving]], Heritage points earned for completing [[lake-temple|temple offerings]], and [[attractions|Attraction]] points earned from building attractions (after reaching town rank A).
Heritage points
Heritage points are gained from completing offerings at the [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]] and [[guardian-mural|Guardian Mural]].

article.x: Museum points
Museum points are gained from donating catchable wildlife (like [[insect|Insect]]s, [[sea-critter|Critter]]s, and [[fish|Fish]]), [[artifact|artifacts]], and [[gem|gems]] to the [[museum|Museum]].
Ocean points
Ocean points are gained from healing coral sites and donating items to [[orchestra-sites|Orchestra sites]].

article.x: Attraction points
Attraction points are gained from building [[attractions|attractions]] after reaching town rank A. They can be built from the [[community-center|Community Center]].
Town ranks explained
Rank F

Rank F is the starter rank. The player has access to basic vegetable crops from [[sam|Sam]] through his [[sams-general-store|General Store]]. The rancher, [[jack|Jack]], sells [[chicken|chicken]]s and [[cow|cow]]s. [[joko|Joko]] and [[dinda|Dinda]], the carpenters, can build [[coop|coop]] and [[mill|mill]] at the [[farm|farm]]. Joko's [[furniture-store|Furniture Store]] sells the Basic, Cabin Wood, and Beach furniture sets.
Rank E

By reaching Rank E, the player unlocks [[fruit-group|fruit]] seeds and more crop seeds from [[sams-general-store|Sam's General Store]]. The rancher, [[jack|Jack]], starts selling [[duck|duck]]s and [[sheep|sheep]]. [[antonio|Antonio]] opens the [[white-flamingo|White Flamingo]] clothing store. More clothing and [[furniture|furniture]] items become available. Tier one of R&D is unlocked at the lab. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town on a regular basis.
Rank D

By reaching Rank D, the player unlocks more and crop seeds at [[sams-general-store|Sam's General Store]]. The rancher, [[jack|Jack]], starts selling [[goat|goat]]s, and [[quail|quails]]. More new [[furniture|furniture]] and [[white-flamingo|clothing]] are also available, and tier two of R&D is unlocked at the lab. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town on a regular basis.
Rank C

By reaching rank C, the player earns 500 [[merit-points|Merit Points]]. They also unlock some [[fall|fall]] seeds, [[winter|winter]] seeds, and [[fruit-tree|fruit tree]]s at [[sams-general-store|Sam's General Store]]. The rancher, [[jack|Jack]], starts selling [[pig|pig]]s and [[peafowl|peafowl]]. [[joko|Joko]] and [[dinda|Dinda]] can now build level 3 [[coop|coop]] and [[barn|barn]]. More new [[furniture|furniture]] and [[white-flamingo|clothing]] are also available, and tier three of R&D is unlocked at the lab. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town on a regular basis.
Rank B

After the player reaches rank B, [[jack|Jack]] starts selling [[llama|llama]] and [[luwak|luwak]]. More new [[furniture|furniture]] and [[white-flamingo|clothing]] are also available. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town on a regular basis.
Rank A

After the player reaches rank A, new clothing becomes available, and the player earns 700 [[merit-points|Merit Points]]. [[connor|Connor]] will mail keys to the cellar on the player's farm , which gives access to more space and production machines. More [[tourists|tourists]] will visit Starlet town on a regular basis.
Rank S
By reaching rank S, the player earns 1000 [[merit-points|Merit Points]]. More [[tourists|tourists]] will be visiting Starlet town on a regular basis.
